steps.title: Complete all modules
steps.description: Follow the lessons at your own pace, on the web or in the app.

steps.title: Do your final work
steps.description: You independently do an installation on a live model.

steps.title: Submit the documentation
steps.description: You photograph the key stages of the work: the starting state, sectioning and placement, bead foundation, weft position and sewing, the finished row, blending and the final result from the required angles. If needed, you also attach a short video of the key technical parts.

steps.title: Nikolina reviews your work
steps.description: You receive feedback within 5 working days. If the work does not yet meet the Brendia Pro® standard, you get concrete feedback and correction instructions and submit the work again.

steps.title: You receive the certificate
steps.description: After your final work is approved you receive the digital and printed Brendia Pro® certificate. With your consent, we add you to the list of certified Brendia Pro® Artists on the website, where clients can find you by city and salon.

valueOfSkill.title: The value of the skill
valueOfSkill.heading: A service that brings clients back to the salon.
valueOfSkill.content: At Studio One by Nina, a sewn-in weft extension installation ranges from €300 to €3,000, depending on the transformation. Maintenance is every 2 to 2.5 months, at the latest after 3 months, and costs €110 to €550; later maintenance is charged at a higher price. A client with extensions thus visits the salon four to five times a year.
valueOfSkill.disclaimer: The amounts are an example from Studio One by Nina and do not include coloring. Prices in your salon depend on your location, price list and clients, and the stated amounts are not a guarantee of earnings.

hero.title: The Story Behind the Brand
hero.description: Brendia Pro® was born from a passion for excellence and a desire to share the art of weft extensions with stylists who want more. What began as a personal professional journey is now becoming a platform for education, growth and a new generation of extension specialists.

founder.name: Nikolina Kljaić
bio: Nikolina Kljaić has been in hairdressing for more than 20 years and is trained in six extension techniques. She has dedicated herself to sewn-in weft extensions since 2020, and they have become her love. At Studio One by Nina she has done more than 350 installations so far. The Brendia Pro® method was born from that experience.

Her journey began in a small salon, where her natural talent and relentless pursuit of perfection quickly set her apart. Clients traveled from across the country to experience her transformative work, and fellow stylists began asking to learn her techniques.

"I realized that my impact could go far beyond my own chair," Nikolina shares. "By teaching others, I could help other stylists build successful careers while giving their clients the confidence that comes with beautiful hair."

Today, Nikolina leads Brendia Pro® with the same passion and attention to detail that defined her work from day one. Every course, every lesson, every interaction reflects her commitment to excellence and genuine care for her students' success.

faqs.question: Who is the Brendia Pro® education intended for?
faqs.answer: The Brendia Pro® education is intended for hairdressers who want to expand their knowledge, refine their technique of working with extensions, and elevate the quality of their services to the next level.

faqs.question: Which programs do you offer?
faqs.answer: We offer five Brendia Pro® programs: Artist Online (€1,600), Artist Online + in person (€3,000), Artist group education (€2,200), Artist 1:1 – one day (€2,500) and Artist 1:1 – two days + online (€4,500). All prices include VAT, and with every program you receive the Brendia Pro® Education Kit and a free Brendia Pro® Masterclass.

faqs.question: Do I need prior experience working with extensions?
faqs.answer: No. All you need is to be a licensed hairdresser.

faqs.question: How long does it take to complete the online course?
faqs.answer: You have 36 months of access to the video lessons from activation, and most participants finish the course in 6 to 8 weeks on average.

faqs.question: Do I need to purchase additional materials?
faqs.answer: No. For the practical part of the Brendia Pro® education, you will receive all the materials needed for practice, except the mannequin head.

faqs.question: Is in-person education available?
faqs.answer: Yes. Besides the online program we offer group education (2 days in a group of 3 to 5 participants), 1:1 programs and the Online + in person combination. Dates for 1:1 education and in-person days are arranged individually, and you confirm your spot by paying a 30% deposit.

faqs.question: How do I become certified?
faqs.answer: Once you complete all the education modules, contact the educator, who will guide you through the next steps required to earn your certificate.

faqs.question: What do I get when I enroll?
faqs.answer: By enrolling you get access to the online education modules through the Brendia Pro® Academy, the Brendia Pro® Education Kit, support during the learning process, a mobile app so you can connect at any time, and the possibility of earning a certificate after successfully completing the education.

faqs.question: What payment options are available?
faqs.answer: With the option of an R-1 invoice, you can pay for the education by card or bank transfer, and in-person education also in cash at Studio One by Nina. By card you can pay in one payment or in interest-free installments, depending on the bank and amount. The detailed installment table by bank is on the Courses page.

faqs.question: Is there a refund policy?
faqs.answer:
Access activation and right of withdrawal. Access to the online education is activated immediately after payment, with your explicit consent to immediate activation and confirmation that by activating you lose the right to unilateral contract withdrawal. After activation, payments are non-refundable. If you are a consumer and access has not yet been activated, you have the legal right to withdraw from the contract within 14 days.

Reservation and date changes. An in-person education date is confirmed by paying a 30% deposit. You can change the date once free of charge if you request the change at least 14 days in advance. In case of cancellation the deposit is not refunded, but with notice at least 14 days before the date it can be transferred to another date.

faqs.question: When do I get access to the education?
faqs.answer: After successful enrollment and confirmed payment, you will receive access to the education platform via email and can start learning.

faqs.question: How long do I have access to the education?
faqs.answer: By purchasing the education you get access to the educational video materials and content through the Brendia Pro® Academy platform for 36 months from the day of activation. After that period you can extend your access according to the Academy's then-current terms and price list. Certified Brendia Pro® Artists remain part of the professional Brendia Pro® community even after their video lesson access expires.

faqs.question: Can I rewatch modules I have already completed?
faqs.answer: Yes. For the duration of your access to the education, you can return to previously completed modules and review the content whenever you need.

faqs.question: Can I contact the educator if I have questions?
faqs.answer: Yes. Throughout the education, you can communicate with the educator, who can help you with questions and concerns about the technique and your progress.

faqs.question: Can I buy professional Brendia Pro® hair and tools?
faqs.answer: Professional Brendia Pro® hair is available to participants who have completed the Brendia Pro® Academy. Tools and consumables can also be made available during the education if needed.

hero.title: Brendia Pro® metoda
hero.subtitle: A professional method of sewn-in weft extensions. No heat or glue, with a discreet result, comfortable to wear and quick to remove.

what.title: What is the Brendia Pro® method
what.p1: The Brendia Pro® method is a professional method of sewn-in weft extensions that Nikolina Kljaić developed through more than 350 installations at Studio One by Nina. The weft is sewn onto a precisely built foundation, without heat or glue, and the weight is distributed through a planned row instead of a large number of individual bonds. That is why the extensions blend better with your own hair.
what.p2: The method's focus is not only on the sewing technique, but on proper hair assessment, placement and the long-term preservation of natural hair. At every maintenance the placement is reassessed and adjusted to the condition of the hair if needed.

comparison.title: The Brendia Pro® method and other installation types
comparison.note: The comparison is general and depends on hair quality and execution.

attachment.bp: The weft is sewn onto a precisely built foundation

weight.keratin: Through a large number of individual bonds
weight.rings: Through a large number of individual bonds

removal.bp: Quick, no glue or keratin removal

maintenance.bp: Every 2 to 2.5 months; the row is quickly removed and reinstalled
maintenance.keratin: The hair can be reinstalled, but about half is lost in removal and needs topping up with new hair

client.title: For the client
items: No heat or glue on your own hair
The same hair is used across multiple maintenances

stylist.title: Benefits for the hairdresser
items: Once the technique is mastered, installation and maintenance are very efficient: the most common two-row installation takes about an hour to an hour and 15 minutes
Quick removal, without painstaking glue removal
Placement and weight distribution are adapted to every client
Satisfied clients who regularly come back for maintenance
